name: Design of Irrigation and Hydraulic Structures
description: Introduction to irrigation engineering, irrigation techniques, quality of irrigation water; Water requirements for crops, duty, delta; Types of irrigation practices – surface, basin, border, furrow, sprinkler, drip; Methods of irrigation; Selection of a suitable irrigation method; Irrigation efficiencies; Soil water – classification, soil water storage, soil moisture constants, soil moisture content. Storage structures: dams and reservoirs; Different types of dams and selection of suitable type and dam site; Gravity dams - load analysis, load combinations, stability analysis, principal stresses, elementary profile. Diversion headworks: layout and components, weirs and barrages; Design concepts for irrigation structures on permeable foundations; Design concepts of weirs and energy dissipation devices. Canals: canal layout and classification; Design concepts of unlined canals – critical tractive force method, Kennedy’s method, Lacey’s method; Economics of canal lining and design of lined canals; Design concepts of canal falls; Design concepts of head regulator, cross regulator; Design concepts of cross drainage work.
